profiles.label: Photography
profiles.definition: credible optics, observed physical surfaces and exposure-dependent detail
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Choose a camera position that explains the subject; preserve believable focal length, occlusion and depth of field
profiles.lighting: physically motivated daylight or controlled studio light
profiles.materials_textures: real surface microtexture and natural imperfections
profiles.color_edges_depth: Organize exposure and white balance; edges follow focus and motion, not arbitrary outlines
profiles.rendering_detail: camera-like tonal response, plausible focus and perspective
profiles.failures_conflicts: Painterly edges, plastic surfaces, impossible reflections and uniform sharpness conflict with optical evidence
profiles.budget_emphasis: Spend tokens on subject, light source, lens behavior and material response before retouch language

profiles.label: Cinematic / Film Still
profiles.definition: narrative staging, production design and layered filmic depth
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Stage a decisive supplied moment with readable blocking, motivated framing and layered planes
profiles.lighting: motivated key light with controlled practical sources
profiles.materials_textures: tangible set materials with restrained film grain
profiles.color_edges_depth: Unify tonal grade while retaining local color; foreground occlusion and focus guide attention
profiles.rendering_detail: cinematic frame with intentional lens behavior and tonal grade
profiles.failures_conflicts: Invented narrative events, gratuitous anamorphic flare and crushed blacks obscure the brief
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize action, blocking, camera placement and motivated light over generic film adjectives

profiles.label: Illustration
profiles.definition: authored line and shape communicate an idea through selective detail
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Make the supplied idea legible through silhouette, grouping and selective exaggeration
profiles.lighting: designed value hierarchy appropriate to drawn forms
profiles.materials_textures: visible brush or line character appropriate to the selected technique
profiles.color_edges_depth: Let contour, flat shape and chosen marks organize space; color relationships support meaning
profiles.rendering_detail: purposeful stylization with clear contour and color organization
profiles.failures_conflicts: Generic digital gloss, indiscriminate detail and unrelated symbolism weaken authored visual decisions
profiles.budget_emphasis: Describe shape and mark grammar before decorative detail

profiles.label: Fine Art / Traditional Media
profiles.definition: physical pigment behavior and hand-made marks on a visible support
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Compose for the physical support and selected mark scale; preserve focal structure
profiles.lighting: light reveals both depicted subject and medium behavior
profiles.materials_textures: paper, canvas or plaster with authentic pigment deposition
profiles.color_edges_depth: Specify how pigment, binder and support produce edges, transparency, impasto or grain
profiles.rendering_detail: observable traditional-media marks rather than a uniform digital filter
profiles.failures_conflicts: A digital filter cannot substitute for authentic deposition; incompatible wet/dry techniques need explicit intent
profiles.budget_emphasis: Name medium behavior and focal marks before optional support texture

profiles.label: 3D / CGI
profiles.definition: modeled volumes, coherent material response and deliberate dimensional lighting
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Use consistent camera projection and modeled scale; maintain contact and occlusion
profiles.lighting: key, fill and contact shadows that establish volume
profiles.materials_textures: physically coherent or deliberately stylized material surfaces
profiles.color_edges_depth: Describe roughness, transmission and specularity separately; edges and subdivision follow construction
profiles.rendering_detail: consistent modeled geometry and spatial occlusion
profiles.failures_conflicts: Melted geometry, floating joints and contradictory reflections break modeled coherence
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize volume, material response and light geometry

profiles.label: Graphic Design
profiles.definition: hierarchy, alignment, visual grouping and composition for communication
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Use grid, alignment, margins and hierarchy to communicate supplied content
profiles.lighting: flat graphic treatment unless showing a printed mockup
profiles.materials_textures: print-aware surfaces or clean digital fields
profiles.color_edges_depth: Color and shape encode roles; depth is optional and must not compete with hierarchy
profiles.rendering_detail: disciplined visual hierarchy with designed shapes and margins
profiles.failures_conflicts: Unrequested copy, pseudo-text and ornamental clutter damage communication
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize information order, spacing and exact supplied text

profiles.label: Vector / Flat Art
profiles.definition: precise contour construction, controlled fills and scalable shape economy
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Build the scene with deliberate paths, overlap and shape economy
profiles.lighting: flat graphic light expressed through deliberate planes
profiles.materials_textures: clean edges with texture only where intrinsic to the style
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use clean contour and controlled fill relationships; depth comes from plane overlap
profiles.rendering_detail: crisp vector-like paths and simple shape relationships
profiles.failures_conflicts: Photographic texture, accidental gradients and tangled paths conflict with vector clarity
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize silhouette, path behavior and fill hierarchy

profiles.label: Cartoon / Animation
profiles.definition: readable silhouettes, expressive staging and simplified appealing forms
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Stage readable poses with clear action lines and balanced exaggeration
profiles.lighting: clear designed values that support pose and expression
profiles.materials_textures: simplified surfaces suited to drawn or tactile animation
profiles.color_edges_depth: Group values and shape families; retain consistent contour and character construction
profiles.rendering_detail: animation-ready shape language with clear focal action
profiles.failures_conflicts: Fused limbs, off-model shapes and arbitrary detail weaken animation readability
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize pose, expression when relevant, silhouette and controlled shape language

profiles.label: Comic / Sequential Art
profiles.definition: ink hierarchy, bounded story moments and panel-aware visual pacing
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Choose one supplied story beat or explicit panel sequence; keep action and reading order clear
profiles.lighting: strong readable shadow groups appropriate to ink
profiles.materials_textures: line, ink masses and print texture where applicable
profiles.color_edges_depth: Ink weights, shadow masses and screen texture define depth and emphasis
profiles.rendering_detail: narrative panel composition with deliberate contour emphasis
profiles.failures_conflicts: Invented speech, extra panels and confusing action continuity obscure the request
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize moment, panel organization, contour hierarchy and exact requested lettering

profiles.label: Anime / Manga
profiles.definition: designed contour shapes, cel or ink value groups and expressive staging
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Use designed silhouettes, expressive staging and consistent anatomy for the supplied subject
profiles.lighting: clean value separation with atmospheric background light
profiles.materials_textures: precise linework and style-specific cel or screen texture
profiles.color_edges_depth: Cel planes or ink/screentone must match the exact substyle; backgrounds support focal forms
profiles.rendering_detail: anime or manga grammar adapted to the chosen subject
profiles.failures_conflicts: Automatic human characters, mismatched rendering and inconsistent facial construction are not style fidelity
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize contour design, value grouping and subject-specific stylization

profiles.label: Concept Art
profiles.definition: functional design ideation, clear silhouettes and world-building evidence
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Choose views that explain design function and scale; detail resolves the focal proposition
profiles.lighting: value masses communicate design before fine detail
profiles.materials_textures: purposeful material indication rather than incidental decoration
profiles.color_edges_depth: Value masses and selective material indications communicate construction
profiles.rendering_detail: production-design study with readable invented function
profiles.failures_conflicts: Polished spectacle without design logic, impossible mechanisms and unrelated world-building are weak
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize functional silhouette and construction before finish

profiles.label: Fantasy
profiles.definition: Coherent imaginative form governed by the supplied extraordinary premise
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Keep supplied imaginative rules legible through scale, staging and coherent relationships
profiles.lighting: Consistent atmospheric or physical light; magical emission only when requested
profiles.materials_textures: invented materials grounded by recognizable natural texture
profiles.color_edges_depth: Ground extraordinary forms in consistent material and lighting behavior
profiles.rendering_detail: Specified fantasy grammar without automatic narrative additions
profiles.failures_conflicts: Automatic magic, medieval scenery or invented characters change intent
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize the specified extraordinary relationship and its physical presentation

profiles.label: Sci-Fi / Futuristic
profiles.definition: speculative function, advanced materials and coherent technological systems
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Explain supplied technology through coherent modules, access and scale
profiles.lighting: practical engineered lighting with restrained emissive accents
profiles.materials_textures: manufactured surfaces and readable construction details
profiles.color_edges_depth: Separate manufactured surfaces, interfaces and emission with consistent light response
profiles.rendering_detail: technology design that communicates purpose and scale
profiles.failures_conflicts: Random greebles, neon and pseudo-labels do not establish technological function
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize functional construction and exact era/subgenre grammar

profiles.label: Architecture / Interior
profiles.definition: spatial clarity, structural proportions and designed material relationships
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Preserve layout, circulation, structural proportions and camera geometry
profiles.lighting: architecturally motivated daylight or installed lighting
profiles.materials_textures: building finishes shown at plausible scale
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use coherent material junctions, verticals and window-to-interior exposure
profiles.rendering_detail: controlled verticals and coherent space without arbitrary distortion
profiles.failures_conflicts: Impossible supports, warped rooms and invented floor plans misrepresent the design
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize spatial organization, construction and light paths

profiles.label: Product / Commercial
profiles.definition: object fidelity, presentation hierarchy and material-led selling detail
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Choose a view that reveals accurate silhouette and defining construction
profiles.lighting: controlled studio or contextual commercial light
profiles.materials_textures: clean manufactured material response with useful detail
profiles.color_edges_depth: Controlled reflection shapes and contact shadows communicate finish without altering color
profiles.rendering_detail: commercial object presentation with readable silhouette
profiles.failures_conflicts: Invented brands, misleading proportions and blown highlights weaken product fidelity
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize product identity, material response and useful detail

profiles.label: Infographic / Educational
profiles.definition: visual hierarchy explains sequence, comparison or function
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Arrange supplied facts into sequence, comparison or functional relationships
profiles.lighting: flat even treatment prioritizing information
profiles.materials_textures: clean diagram surfaces with consistent symbol vocabulary
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use a consistent symbol grammar, alignment and color role; keep leaders unambiguous
profiles.rendering_detail: ordered explanatory structure and unobscured relationships
profiles.failures_conflicts: Fabricated data, unsupported causal claims and pseudo-text are unacceptable
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize information correctness, relational structure and exact labels

profiles.label: Coloring Page / Line Art
profiles.definition: closed black contours on white with colorable regions
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Keep margins, enclosed regions and readable overlaps appropriate to intended complexity
profiles.lighting: no tonal shading or grey fill
profiles.materials_textures: pure white paper and clear black lines
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use distinct black contours on a plain light field; no tonal fills unless explicitly required
profiles.rendering_detail: printable line-art boundaries, clear margins and unfilled interiors
profiles.failures_conflicts: Broken outlines, gray shading and tiny accidental regions defeat colorability
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize enclosure, line weight, count and printable spacing

profiles.label: Pixel Art
profiles.definition: intentional square clusters and palette economy at visible low resolution
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Choose a consistent pixel grid and readable cluster scale
profiles.lighting: lighting represented by discrete pixel-value groups
profiles.materials_textures: hard unfiltered pixel edges and controlled dithering
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use discrete color ramps, purposeful stepping and selective dithering
profiles.rendering_detail: nearest-neighbor pixel structure without smooth anti-aliasing
profiles.failures_conflicts: Smooth interpolation, mixed resolution and random pixel noise contradict the medium
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize cluster design, palette roles and silhouette

profiles.label: Isometric
profiles.definition: equal-axis parallel projection and legible spatial layering
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Maintain one parallel projection with shared axes and consistent scale
profiles.lighting: consistent light across parallel planes
profiles.materials_textures: style-appropriate surfaces subordinate to spatial clarity
profiles.color_edges_depth: Plane values and occlusion explain depth without vanishing-point convergence
profiles.rendering_detail: 30-degree isometric axes, parallel edges, no vanishing point
profiles.failures_conflicts: Mixed camera systems or inconsistent axis slopes destroy spatial coherence
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize projection, footprint, contacts and plane hierarchy

profiles.label: Low-Poly / Voxel / Game-Stylized
profiles.definition: economical geometry and gameplay-readable silhouette
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Make silhouette and spatial use readable at the intended game scale
profiles.lighting: clear value groups and simple directional light
profiles.materials_textures: faceted, cubic or hand-painted surfaces as specified
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use the exact selected geometry system: facets, cubes or stylized meshes; keep material hierarchy simple
profiles.rendering_detail: deliberate geometry simplification with readable game function
profiles.failures_conflicts: Mixing voxel and polygon rules or noisy detail obscures construction
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize geometric grammar and action-readable form

profiles.label: Paper / Craft / Handmade
profiles.definition: visible construction, tactile material and hand-made variation
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Show how material pieces join, fold, overlap and support the supplied form
profiles.lighting: soft raking light reveals edges, seams and fibers
profiles.materials_textures: paper, cloth, wood or clay with authentic craft evidence
profiles.color_edges_depth: Edges, seams, fibers and thickness create tactile depth under suitable light
profiles.rendering_detail: physically assembled craft object or flat handmade composition
profiles.failures_conflicts: Seamless plastic, impossible folds and texture pasted across joins betray the medium
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize construction evidence and material-specific surface behavior

profiles.label: Icon / UI Asset
profiles.definition: compact recognizability, optical balance and consistent asset boundaries
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Design for small-size recognition, optical balance and clear safe margins
profiles.lighting: simple clear light that preserves tiny-scale silhouette
profiles.materials_textures: clean compact surfaces without distracting detail
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use consistent stroke, fill or volumetric grammar for the exact icon type
profiles.rendering_detail: single UI asset or explicitly specified set with safe margins
profiles.failures_conflicts: Tiny text, busy scenery and unequal stroke weight reduce utility
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize silhouette, internal gaps and compact recognition anchors

profiles.label: Pattern / Decorative
profiles.definition: repeat rhythm, motif hierarchy and coherent surface coverage
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Establish repeat unit, interval and motif hierarchy across the field
profiles.lighting: flat even surface treatment
profiles.materials_textures: surface-design texture appropriate to medium
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use consistent motif scale and edge continuation with a controlled surface treatment
profiles.rendering_detail: controlled repetition and balanced intermotif spacing
profiles.failures_conflicts: Random placement, unintended seams and excessive focal variation break repetition
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize repeat structure and motif relationships

profiles.label: Abstract / Experimental
profiles.definition: nonliteral relationships of shape, material, light or process
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Make the selected process or relationship observable through hierarchy and rhythm
profiles.lighting: light or value treatment serves the chosen abstraction
profiles.materials_textures: observable medium or process rather than arbitrary decoration
profiles.color_edges_depth: Shape, light, surface and mark behavior must obey the chosen abstraction
profiles.rendering_detail: nonrepresentational visual structure without benchmark subject constraints
profiles.failures_conflicts: Random decoration, literal benchmark objects and undifferentiated noise weaken intent
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize process-specific evidence rather than invented narrative

profiles.label: Retro / Vintage
profiles.definition: era-specific form, reproduction behavior and historically coherent palette
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Use one coherent period vocabulary for layout and reproduction
profiles.lighting: period-appropriate graphic or photographic treatment
profiles.materials_textures: analog print, paper or period digital surface as specified
profiles.color_edges_depth: Distinguish print, photographic and early digital behavior; aging remains subordinate
profiles.rendering_detail: coherent era vocabulary without mixing unrelated decades
profiles.failures_conflicts: Mixed eras, compulsory palettes and fake historical text are misleading
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize period shape and reproduction grammar over damage

profiles.label: Minimal / Clean
profiles.definition: essential forms, deliberate omission and measured negative space
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Retain every required element while reducing incidental competition
profiles.lighting: restrained clear lighting or flat graphic values
profiles.materials_textures: quiet surfaces without incidental clutter
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use deliberate negative space, precise edges and restrained tonal hierarchy
profiles.rendering_detail: Reduced incidental detail while retaining every user-required element
profiles.failures_conflicts: Removing invariants or flattening all material differences is not useful minimalism
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize placement, proportion and essential distinctions

profiles.label: Surreal / Dreamlike
profiles.definition: one legible impossible relationship within an otherwise coherent world
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Make the supplied impossible relationship deliberate while preserving local coherence
profiles.lighting: atmospheric light supporting the specific spatial paradox
profiles.materials_textures: credible or illustrative surfaces consistent within the image
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use consistent rendering and selective perceptual uncertainty rather than universal blur
profiles.rendering_detail: intentional dream logic with a visible focal contradiction
profiles.failures_conflicts: Accidental geometry errors, invented symbolism and lost counts are not dream logic
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize the exact paradox and readable anchors

profiles.label: Map / Spatial Illustration
profiles.definition: spatial topology, geographic hierarchy and consistent landmark symbols
profiles.composition_viewpoint: Preserve topology, adjacency, route continuity and supplied geographic hierarchy
profiles.lighting: flat map light or controlled relief shading
profiles.materials_textures: map substrate and symbols appropriate to the map purpose
profiles.color_edges_depth: Use a consistent symbol key, scale treatment and relief convention
profiles.rendering_detail: readable routes and terrain relationships across one geographic field
profiles.failures_conflicts: Invented places, false connections and meaningless labels undermine spatial communication
profiles.budget_emphasis: Prioritize topology and exact supplied names before ornament
